docs.summary: Inherited rendering context passed down the UI hierarchy during [`GameCanvas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GameCanvas) tree construction. Accumulates values from [`CanvasGroup`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.CanvasGroup) components.
Accumulated alpha multiplier (1 = fully opaque, 0 = fully transparent). Each [`CanvasGroup`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.CanvasGroup) multiplies its own alpha into this value.

Whether pointer events should be processed for elements under this context. A [`CanvasGroup`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.CanvasGroup) with [`Interactable`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.CanvasGroup~Interactable) set to `false` disables interaction for all descendants.
Whether raycasts (pointer hit-testing) are blocked by elements in this context.
Creates a default context with full opacity and all interaction enabled.
